verdict.rationale: AMD's official ROCm docs explicitly list RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) support with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and ONNX on Linux and PyTorch on Windows, plus a documented install matrix and support for vLLM/Llama.cpp/SGLang frameworks. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports confirming real-world install success/performance parity, and version-specific compatibility matrix detail (exact PyTorch/ROCm version pairing) beyond doc mentions.
